subject: OrbisData — request: risk adjustments + commercial variance for pilot
messages:
From: Lenora Hayes <lenora@orbisdata.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Simon Klein <simon.klein@bindleylegals.com>, cfo@orbisdata.com
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot contract redlines + pricing request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team was impressed with latency and observability. We're keen to move the pilot forward but legal pushed a few redlines and finance asked for a deeper pilot discount. Attached are the proposed contract edits (OrbisData_Redlines_20280503.docx) and a marked SOW. High level asks from our side: 

- Increase supplier liability cap to $5,000,000 (we understand this is above your standard).
- Modify indemnity to be mutual and remove the carveout for third-party data processing claims.
- Extend warranty period to 12 months and add uptime performance credits.
- 35% discount on list for the 6-month pilot (scale to 20% on annual renewal).

We want to keep this simple — can you confirm whether any of these are deal-breakers for Redwood or if senior approval is required? Happy to set a quick call.

Lenora
Lenora Hayes
Head of Procurement, OrbisData
lenora@orbisdata.com

Attachments: OrbisData_Redlines_20280503.docx (tracked redlines), SOW_OrbisData_Pilot_v1.pdf

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding OrbisData's redlines and asks. TL;DR: they want a $5M cap, mutual indemnity language that broadens exposure, a 12-month warranty, and a 35% pilot discount.

My read: pilot is strategic (large potential ARR) but the legal redlines materially increase risk exposure. Sales would like to offer a better commercial to lock them in. Requesting:

1) Exec OK to increase liability cap to $5M conditioned on higher pricing or additional customer insurance proof.
2) Guidance from Legal (Aditya) on whether indemnity edits are acceptable or require exec-level carveouts.
3) Approval for up to 30% pilot discount from Deal Desk (Marissa) or firm no-go above 25%.

Attachments: OrbisData_Redlines_20280503.docx, SOW_OrbisData_Pilot_v1.pdf

Can you both weigh in by EOD PST? If folks prefer, we can sync with Lenora tomorrow.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Sr. Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot contract redlines + pricing request

Thanks Steph — appreciate the quick flag. Context from my side: Orbis is a strong inbound, procurement is serious but price sensitive; CFO is driving the 35% ask. Commercial objectives: secure pilot ASAP, convert to production within 12 months, and get annual commitment thereafter.

Proposed commercial compromise (recommendation):
- Pilot discount: approve up to 30% on list for a 6-month pilot if Orbis commits to an LOI for a 12-month renewal at minimum 20% discount.
- Liability cap: approve raising to $5M for the pilot only if they accept a carve-out: cap applies to direct damages only, and Orbis must provide an insurance certificate (cyber liability) with limits >= $5M.
- Indemnity: we should push for mutual indemnity but preserve Redwood's IP carve-out and refuse any liability for Orbis' customer data claims beyond direct damages.
- Warranty: counter with 90 days (not 12 months) plus targeted uptime SLO credits in SOW.

I think these are commercially reasonable. I'm prepared to sign off on 30% pilot discount + conditional $5M cap if Legal concurs and Exec signs the risk exception for indemnity carveouts.

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot contract redlines + pricing request — legal analysis

Team — quick legal read after review of the redlines (see attached comments in OrbisData_Redlines_20280503.docx):

- Liability cap to $5M: elevates risk materially above our standard $1M cap. Acceptable for a time-limited pilot if (a) it's explicitly limited to direct damages, (b) we get a certificate of insurance naming Redwood as an additional insured, and (c) we include an indemnity dollar cap tied to the cap.
- Indemnity changes: Orbis seeks to remove the third-party data-processing carveout — can't agree. We must retain the carveout that limits our exposure for customer data processed by Orbis or its customers, and preserve Redwood's IP indemnity. Any broad indemnity language that is open-ended will need exec approval and a commercial premium.
- Warranty: 12 months is excessive for an inference service. Recommend 90-day warranty tied to performance tests + service credits; longer terms require price/insurance concessions.

Action items for exec packet:
1) Approval to grant a pilot-only liability cap of $5M subject to conditions above.
2) Approval to decline broad indemnity redlines; provide authority to accept mutual indemnity only if limited to direct damages and excluding Redwood IP and third-party data claims.
3) Authorization for a one-time discount up to 30% for the pilot if commercial/insurance conditions are met.

If you want I can draft a short memo for Marissa to include in the Deal Desk note for Exec approval.

—Aditya
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Lenora Hayes <lenora@orbisdata.com>
Date: Sat, 04 May 2028 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot contract redlines + pricing request — Exec approval granted

Lenora / Team — following internal review and conversations, Redwood can proceed with the pilot under these conditions (approved by revenue leadership and legal):

1) Liability cap: Redwood will accept a pilot-only liability cap of $5,000,000 limited to direct damages only. Orbis must provide a certificate of cyber liability insurance listing Redwood as an additional insured with limits of at least $5M prior to contract execution.
2) Indemnity: We will accept mutual indemnity limited to direct damages and excluding Redwood's IP and claims arising from Orbis' customers or processors. Broad third-party data-processing indemnities are not acceptable.
3) Warranty: 90-day warranty tied to the performance acceptance tests in the SOW; uptime credits limited as described in the attached SOW.
4) Pricing: Pilot discount approved at 30% on list for the 6-month pilot, conditioned on a signed LOI for a 12-month renewal with a minimum 20% discount.

Please confirm acceptance on your side and we'll circulate the counter-signed SOW and a DocuSign for signatures.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOW_OrbisData_Pilot_v1.pdf, OrbisData_Redlines_20280503.docx (our annotated counter)
